explicit_lattice_bridge.basis_convention: rows of T are the standard fiber basis written in the archived Roulleau A1,...,A14 basis

primary_lineage.article: Clingher--Malmendier, On K3 surfaces of Picard rank 14

exact_locations.Lemma_2_2: the general P'_14=H+D8(-1)+D4(-1) surface has a frame (D8+D4,trivial MW)
exact_locations.Theorem_1_5: the coarse P'_14 moduli space has dimension six
exact_locations.Theorem_3_7: the standard Jacobian fibration has fibers I4*+I0*+8I1 and trivial Mordell--Weil group

primary_lineage.relation_to_present_equation: the displayed short-Weierstrass equation is a normalized six-parameter open chart of the published standard fibration

scope.known_algebraic_family: the underlying P'_14 family and its standard I4*+I0* fibration are published; the gain is the explicit attachment to H13/50
scope.not_automorphism_fixed: no surface automorphism is asserted to preserve this transported chamber
scope.not_full_nef: ten primitive square-minus-four mirrors prevent interpreting the 50-wall chamber as the full K3 nef cone
scope.novelty: not a new abstract polytope and no worldwide priority claim for the equation or carrier attachment
scope.positive_gain: an equation-level characteristic-zero K3 realization of all fifty H13/50 divisor mirrors on the full very-general Picard lattice

theorem: On a nonempty open set, the very general minimal resolution of y^2=x^3+t^2*P(t)*x+t^3*Q(t) has exact NS=U+D8(-1)+D4(-1) and carries, through an explicit unimodular marking, all fifty mirrors of the finite-volume noncompact SS2-2A H13/50 chamber.

transported_H13_50_mirrors.effectivity_scope: after Weyl-transporting the marking to an ample chamber, K3 Riemann--Roch orients the forty square-minus-two classes as effective divisors; they may be reducible and are not asserted to be all curve walls.  The ten square-minus-four mirrors are algebraic divisor reflections, not curve walls.

very_general_picard_lattice.generic_rank_argument: the normalized equations have six recovered parameters and finite marked-coordinate stabilizer, hence a six-dimensional image in K3 moduli; rho>=14 from U+D8+D4, while the locus rho>=15 has dimension at most five

torsion_saturation.conclusion: Mordell--Weil torsion is trivial and the trivial lattice is saturated

normalization.stabilizer_argument: t->lambda*t and (x,y)->(mu^2*x,mu^3*y): the leading pair gives mu^2=lambda^3, while the normalized 6*t^5 term gives lambda=1; only the finite mu^2=1 ambiguity remains
